:root{--color-bg:#faf7f2;--color-surface:#ffffff;--color-text:#2b2b2b;--color-text-muted:#5a5a5a;--color-brand-dark:#2f5233;--color-brand:#4c8c4a;--color-accent:#b35a00;--color-accent-on-dark:#ffd59e;--color-dark-bg:#1f3b22;--color-border:#e0dccf;--radius:0.5rem;--space-1:0.5rem;--space-2:1rem;--space-3:1.5rem;--space-4:2.5rem;--font-body:Verdana, Geneva, sans-serif;--max-width:1100px;}*{box-sizing:border-box;}html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}body{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-body);background:var(--color-bg);color:var(--color-text);line-height:1.6;}h1,h2,h3{font-family:Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;color:var(--color-brand-dark);line-height:1.2;margin-top:0;}p{margin-top:0;}a{color:var(--color-brand-dark);}a:focus,button:focus,input:focus,textarea:focus{outline:3px solid var(--color-accent);outline-offset:2px;}.container{max-width:var(--max-width);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1rem;width:100%;}header{background:var(--color-surface);border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border);}.header-inner{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:var(--space-2);padding-top:var(--space-2);padding-bottom:var(--space-2);}.logo{font-family:Impact, 'Arial Black', sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.05em;font-size:clamp(1.2rem,4vw,1.7rem);color:var(--color-brand-dark);text-decoration:none;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 var(--color-accent);transform:skew(-6deg);display:inline-block;}nav[aria-label='Main'] ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--space-2);margin:0;padding:0;}nav[aria-label='Main'] a{text-decoration:none;font-weight:bold;color:var(--color-brand-dark);padding:0.4rem 0.2rem;}nav[aria-label='Main'] a:hover{text-decoration:underline;}main{display:block;}section{padding:var(--space-4) 0;}section:nth-of-type(even){background:var(--color-surface);}footer{background:var(--color-dark-bg);color:var(--color-accent-on-dark);padding:var(--space-3) 0;}.footer-inner{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:var(--space-1);}.footer-logo{font-family:Impact, 'Arial Black', sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.05em;font-size:1.3rem;color:var(--color-accent-on-dark);margin:0;}footer address{font-style:normal;color:var(--color-accent-on-dark);}footer a{color:var(--color-accent-on-dark);}.copyright{font-size:0.85rem;margin-top:var(--space-1);}.btn{display:inline-block;background:var(--color-brand-dark);color:#ffffff;border:none;padding:0.8rem 1.6rem;min-height:44px;border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:1rem;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;}.btn:hover{background:#243f27;}.btn-outline{background:transparent;border:2px solid var(--color-brand-dark);color:var(--color-brand-dark);}.card{background:var(--color-surface);border:1px solid var(--color-border);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:var(--space-2);}.grid{display:grid;gap:var(--space-2);grid-template-columns:1fr;}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;}th,td{text-align:left;padding:0.6rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border);}form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:var(--space-2);max-width:30rem;}label{font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:0.3rem;display:block;}input,textarea{width:100%;padding:0.7rem;min-height:44px;border:1px solid var(--color-border);border-radius:var(--radius);font-family:inherit;font-size:1rem;}textarea{min-height:88px;}img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;}@media (max-width:600px){.header-inner{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;}nav[aria-label='Main'] ul{flex-direction:column;gap:0.3rem;width:100%;}section{padding:var(--space-3) 0;}.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}@media (min-width:601px){.grid-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}.grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}.header-inner{flex-wrap:nowrap;}}

pages.title: Root & Smoke – Vegan Food Truck
pages.html:
🔥 ROOT & SMOKE
  • This Week's Spot
  • Menu
  • About
  • Testimonials
  • Contact

Root & Smoke — Vegan Food Truck

Bold, plant-based BBQ and street food, smoked low and slow, served fast and fresh wherever we park this week.

Find Us This Week See the Menu

This Week's Spot

We move around the city, but you can always catch us at one of these spots. Check back weekly for updates!

Weekly Schedule

Food truck location schedule for this week
DayLocationHours
MondayFernwood Park, SE 21st Ave11am – 2pm
TuesdayHawthorne & 34th11am – 2pm
WednesdayClosed — truck maintenance—
ThursdayLaurelhurst Market Lot4pm – 8pm
FridayDivision Street Night Market5pm – 9pm
SaturdayFernwood Farmers Market9am – 1pm
SundayWillamette Riverside Park12pm – 5pm

Find Us On the Map

Today's exact spot is always pinned on our social media by 9am — follow along so you never miss us!

The Menu

Everything is 100% plant-based, made fresh daily from scratch. Smoked, grilled, or fried — it's all soul food, no animals required.

Smokehouse Mains

Jackfruit Brisket Plate

Smoked jackfruit brisket, house BBQ sauce, two sides of your choice.

$14

Smoky Mushroom Ribs

King oyster mushroom "ribs" glazed and grilled, served with slaw.

$13

Pulled BBQ Soy Curls

Tender pulled soy curls in smoky sauce on a toasted bun.

$12

Handhelds & Snacks

Smoke Stack Tacos (3)

Chipotle jackfruit, avocado crema, pickled onion, corn tortillas.

$11

Loaded Smoky Fries

Crispy fries, queso drizzle, pulled soy curls, scallions.

$9

Cornbread Bites

Sweet skillet cornbread bites with maple-chili butter.

$6

Sides & Drinks

Smoked Mac & "Cheese"

Creamy cashew cheese sauce, smoked paprika breadcrumb topping.

$6

Charred Corn Slaw

Crisp cabbage, charred corn, lime-cilantro dressing.

$5

Hibiscus Switchel

House-made ginger and hibiscus switchel, served over ice.

$4

Our Story

Root & Smoke started in 2019 when two backyard-BBQ-loving vegans, Mara and Theo, decided Portland needed smoky comfort food without the meat. What began as a single smoker at the farmers market has grown into a full truck serving thousands of neighbors every month.

We believe great flavor shouldn't cost the planet. Every dish is built from whole, plant-based ingredients, slow-smoked the old-fashioned way, and served with the same hospitality you'd find at a family cookout.

What We Stand For

  • 100% plant-based, always
  • Locally sourced produce whenever possible
  • Compostable packaging, zero styrofoam
  • Fair wages for our whole crew

What Our Customers Say

“The jackfruit brisket plate converted my meat-eating husband on the spot. We chase this truck all over town.”

— Priya S., Hawthorne District

“Best mac and cheese I've had, vegan or not. The smoky flavor is unreal.”

— Daniel R., Laurelhurst

“Friendly crew, fast service, and food that actually fills you up. Our Friday night tradition now.”

— Grace L., Division St.

Visit Us & Stay in Touch

Hours This Week

  • Mon, Tue: 11am – 2pm
  • Wed: Closed
  • Thu: 4pm – 8pm
  • Fri: 5pm – 9pm
  • Sat: 9am – 1pm
  • Sun: 12pm – 5pm

Get In Touch

123 Fernwood Ave, Portland, OR 97214
(503) 555-1234
hello@rootandsmoke.com

Never Miss a Spot

Sign up for our weekly newsletter and get next week's locations, specials, and menu drops in your inbox.

Root & Smoke

123 Fernwood Ave, Portland, OR 97214
(503) 555-1234
hello@rootandsmoke.com
